title: Cosmere - Cold Sweat | Compatibility Pack
description: Bridges Cosmere's Warmth to ColdSweat's Temperature, enabling Brass Feruchemy interaction.
body:
# The Pack
Save yourself from freezing and from having a heatstroke using feruchemy!

This datapack bridges Cosmere's Warmth to ColdSweat's Temperature, enabling Brass Feruchemy interaction.


# Changes

Tapping and Filling Brass makes you hotter and colder respectively in ColdSweat's Temperature.
This is done by adding a fraction of your warmth, a Cosmere attribute, to your ColdSweat Temperature.
Beware, you can still be set on fire!

# Dependencies

This datapack requires [Cosmere by leafreynolds](https://modrinth.com/mod/cosmere) and [ColdSweat by Mikul](https://modrinth.com/mod/cold-sweat)

However, it is only useful if [Feruchemy by leafreynolds](https://modrinth.com/mod/feruchemy) is also included. In case another of leafreynolds's mods also affects warmth, this datapack will probably still be compatible.

Thanks to both mods for their easily accessible APIs!
